assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
in the context of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9, I48.0)
personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
a 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is indicated
to detect asymptomatic or symptomatic atrial fibrillation episodes that may require anticoagulation management
This prolonged rhythm monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate the documented symptoms and the patient's elevated stroke risk
directly countering the PR-204 determination that the diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
